title: Good glass but there are some flaws with this set!
text: Good glass but there are some flaws with this set!. The funnel included is a cool concept but it’s not narrow enough to fit in the neck of the bottle. Also, the black lid seals are too big and flop and hang over the lid instead of being tight and professional looking. These are the 2 flaws. Everything else is pretty good with this. The spout insert snaps tightly into place, the lid screws on tight. The glass is without flaw and doesn’t wobble on surfaces.
